limitations: Official run/job metadata and decoded-log provenance are supplied externally; no online authenticity check.
Compact receipts do not independently audit APK binaries, raw JUnit files, native libraries, installed bytes or ACL files.
records_sha256 is reconstructed exactly; raw_log_sha256 is only linked between CONTEXT and FINAL.
Group post-environment equality is a bound-controller PASS claim; only its before environment hash is directly forwarded.
All diagnostics are instrumented observations. No formal gate, product speedup, pure lock-wait or additive causal attribution is claimed.
